answer: Quick check before I dive in — the "dim because of the trees" thing was your old place; when you moved in 2024 you told me the new top-floor apartment has big south-facing windows and the living room gets flooded with sun most of the day. Are you asking about a different room, or has something changed since then? If it really is dim now, the plan we worked out before still applies: one large mirror across from the windows plus layered lighting — an uplight floor lamp in the dark corner and table lamps flanking the sofa, all at 2700-3000K, aiming for roughly 3,000-5,000 lumens total.
